title: Content Telemetry Manifest
description: Schema for the .well-known/content-telemetry.json manifest defined in section 8 of the Content Telemetry specification. A manifest declares a participant's identity, roles, telemetry endpoint, signing keys, and claimed domains.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. v1 emitters MUST use '1.0'. (Section 8.2)

id.description: The manifest's canonical https URL, ending in /.well-known/content-telemetry.json, e.g. https://example.com/.well-known/content-telemetry.json. (Section 8.2)

roles.description: One or more of content_owner, agent, platform. (Section 8.2)

name.description: Display name of the operating organisation. (Section 8.3)

domain.description: Primary domain. Defaults to the manifest URL's host. (Section 8.3)

id.description: Key identifier, unique within the manifest. (Section 8.4)

type.description: Key type. v1 defines Ed25519 only. (Section 8.4)

publicKey.description: Multibase-encoded public key (multicodec prefix, base58btc - the same format as did:key). (Section 8.4)

keys.description: Public keys for signing telemetry events. Per-event signing is informational in v1. (Section 8.4)

endpoint.description: HTTPS URL (schema-enforced). For agents and platforms, the outbound submission endpoint. For content owners, the inbound destination for events about the owner's content. (Section 8.5)

conformance_level.description: Conformance level advertised by this participant's own emitter(s). Informational. (Sections 8.5, 5.7)

ctx_resolution.description: HTTPS URL of the click-token resolution endpoint operated by or for this participant. Valid on agent and platform manifests (enforced at the application layer). Destinations resolve ctx_iss to this manifest and present the token here. (Section 7.4)

coverage.description: Per-event-type coverage declaration, a map from event type to a mode object. A claim subject to the rules of section 5.7.6: complete asserts every qualifying occurrence within the declared relationship scope is emitted. (Sections 8.5, 5.7.6)

terms_ref.description: Reference to the terms stating the sampling, aggregation or selection rule and the relationship scope (section 5.2.4)

domains.description: Domains the participant claims authority over. MAY appear only on root manifests (enforced at the application layer); each entry MUST be the manifest's own host or a subdomain of it (literal or wildcard). (Section 8.6)

prefix.description: The content_id prefix claimed, matched against content_id values up to and including the prefix, e.g. ft: or mkt:gridnews:. (Section 8.6)

resolution.description: HTTPS URL of an endpoint mapping a content_id under this prefix to the owning content record or organisation. (Section 8.6)

identifier_schemes.description: Identifier prefixes the participant claims for content_id routing. MAY appear only on content_owner manifests (enforced at the application layer); prefix ownership is verified by the consumer at registration. (Sections 7.3, 8.6)
